mechanism: Clotrimazole inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, which may increase olanzapine levels; clotrimazole can also cause QT prolongation additively with olanzapine's cardiac effects.
action: Monitor for increased olanzapine adverse effects (sedation, orthostasis, weight gain) and cardiac symptoms; consider ECG if prolonged QT risk factors present; ensure appropriate antifungal duration.
